name: Monthly spend chart
summary: Six months of spend as bars, with the current month's forecast hatched on top, a dashed budget line and a tooltip on the bar you point at.
use: for monthly spend or usage against a budget, with a forecast
a11y: Each bar is a button whose name says the month, the amount and how it sits against the budget; Tab moves through the months and shows the same tooltip as hover.

use_when: a billing or usage page that must warn early when the month is heading over budget
avoid_when: a share of a whole, such as spend by team: use donut-breakdown
a few headline numbers with no monthly history: use kpi-strip or budget-meters
more or fewer than six periods: the columns are fixed at six

parts.name: subtitle
parts.what: the date range and when the data was updated

parts.name: stats
parts.what: one headline figure: a label and a value; the forecast can carry an over-budget badge

parts.name: over
parts.what: the forecast as a share of budget, in a warning badge

parts.name: axis
parts.what: one value label on the side axis

parts.name: budget
parts.what: the dashed budget line and its label

parts.name: months
parts.what: one month's bar, with a tooltip of its figures on hover or focus; the current month adds a hatched forecast

parts.name: tip
parts.what: the month name and its figures, label then value

parts.name: x_labels
parts.what: one short month name under the bars

parts.name: legend
parts.what: one legend key: spent, forecast or budget

empty.how: with no months of data, keep the heading and axis and put a short empty-state line across the plot

loading.how: show the card with grey blocks in place of the figures and six short grey bars

error.how: if the spend data fails to load, replace the plot with an alert-banners line and a retry button

disabled.how: the bars have no action to disable; nothing to build unless they open a month

overflow.how: in a narrow box every tooltip moves to the plot's top-left corner so it cannot run past the card

long_text.how: the heading and figures wrap onto separate lines; figures, axis labels and the budget label never break
long_text.evidence: flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: start; justify-content: space-between

keyboard: Tab moves through the six month bars in order
A focused bar shows its tooltip and dims the other bars, as hover does
